_comment: Ground truth for VAmPI (vulnerable=1), confirmed by hand against the running container on 2026-09-12. Only rows personally reproduced are must_detect:true so recall stays honest. Match key = check|METHOD|path.

expected.note: GET /users/v1/admin' returns sqlalchemy/sqlite3 OperationalError with the raw SQL.
Debug endpoint returns every user's cleartext password.
register accepts admin:true; the created principal comes back admin in /users/v1/_debug.
Any authenticated user can read another user's book secret; docstring claims owner-only.

VAmPI signs JWTs with a hardcoded HMAC secret present in payloads/jwt-secrets.txt; oedipus verifies the target's own token signature against the wordlist offline. Not toggled by vulnerable=0, so excluded from the safe-target FP control.
